***

**(InStyle.com)** — As an aspiring nine-year-old ballerina, Brooke Burns took an overly enthusiastic approach to cosmetics. "I would borrow my mother's red Borghese lipstick and smear it on like a clown!" she recalls. "And for creating sultry eyes, there is still nothing better than a classic drugstore black liner." 

Today, the 29-year-old single mother and star of the ABC comedy *Miss Guided* strives to pass down more refined beauty tips to her seven-year-old daughter. "I taught her that 'a dab’ll do ya,'" says the actress. "She is going to experiment with makeup anyway, so she might as well gain some proper experience."

***

**Q: Did you pick up any favorite beauty tricks during your time as a model?**  
**A:** One of my favorites is applying a white eyeliner pencil along the inner bottom rim of the eyelid to create an instantly bright, wide-awake look. For an effortless evening look when I’m short on time, I simply apply a generous amount of mascara and sweep a black pencil all the way around the inner rim. It creates a stunning, sultry eye in just a minute and a half.

**Q: What is the one makeup item you cannot live without?**  
**A:** I am absolutely in love with Revlon ColorStay Foundation. I can go through any activity wearing it, and it stays perfectly in place. Plus, it contains sunscreen, provides full coverage, and gives my skin a genuinely natural glow. 

**Q: You alternate between blonde and brunette. Which do you prefer?**  
**A:** My natural shade is a dark blonde, but right now I really prefer being a brunette. I did a film last summer where they dyed my hair platinum, and I hated it. I have a big personality, and I feel that having platinum blonde hair on top of that made me come across as glib. With dark hair, people actually focus on your face—before, it was all about the hair.

**Q: How do you keep color-treated hair healthy?**  
**A:** I have never found a conditioner that leaves my hair feeling as extraordinary as Nature's Therapy Mega Moisture Nurturing Shampoo by L'Oréal. My hairstylist used it on me once, and now I am completely obsessed. I also use a hair color from Paul Mitchell called "Fudge Brownie," which is incredible. I constantly have people complimenting me, saying, "Your hair looks so healthy!"

**Q: Have you always had great hair?**  
**A:** Not at all. I had massive hair in high school—I was a heavy user of hot rollers, teasing, and I had full-on mall bangs. I also wore my hair in a tight bun a lot because of all my ballet training. Truthfully, I wasn't popular in high school at all.

**Q: Most people would find it hard to believe you weren't popular.**  
**A:** My nickname was actually "Olive Oyl." I was completely gangly and a full foot taller than all the boys. It was not an attractive phase!

**Q: You have certainly come a long way. What is your secret?**  
**A:** I believe it is essential to take meticulous care of your skin. Obviously, the number one priority is sunscreen. All my life, I have used Oil of Olay as my daytime moisturizer because my mother always did. I also use their foaming face wash, which is the best makeup remover ever created. In the morning, I use Olay Age Defying Daily Renewal Cleanser because it features tiny microbeads that are fantastic for gentle exfoliation. People often say, "You have such great skin!" and I think to myself, *Thank God I’m not spending $150 on luxury products.* I am sure those high-end products are wonderful, but if it isn't broken, don't fix it.

***

Over her years in the entertainment industry, actress Brooke Burns has seen her approach to beauty evolve from high-maintenance routines to an emphasis on effortless, natural style. **The Art of Effortless Beauty: Brooke Burns on Simplicity, Drugstore Gems, and Natural Radiance**

In an industry famous for multi-step cosmetic regimens and high-maintenance upkeep, actress and television host Brooke Burns takes a refreshingly grounded approach to personal care. Having spent decades in front of the camera—first as a fashion model and later as a star in film and television—Burns has mastered the art of looking effortlessly radiant without spending hours in a vanity chair. Her beauty philosophy rests on a simple premise: a streamlined routine built on smart, targeted techniques, accessible products, and a deep understanding of what truly flatters one’s natural features can consistently yield sophisticated results.

### Embracing Richer Tones and Healthy Hair Treatments

For years, the demands of modeling and acting required frequent color changes and heavy heat styling, which took a predictable toll on Burns’ hair. Through her career, she learned from top industry stylists that health, rather than high-maintenance processing, is the true foundation of great hair. 

Burns eventually transitioned away from high-contrast highlights, choosing instead to keep her hair in a richer, darker shade. Embracing darker locks not only restored the natural luster and strength of her hair, but it also created a striking contrast that beautifully frames her face and accentuates her bright eyes. To maintain this health, she incorporates specialized deep-conditioning treatments learned during her modeling days, ensuring her hair remains hydrated, manageable, and vibrant with minimal daily effort.

### High-Low Glamour: The Power of Drugstore Favorites

When it comes to her cosmetics bag, Burns firmly dispels the myth that luxury price tags are a prerequisite for elegance. Her routine relies heavily on preferred drugstore products that deliver high-performance results without unnecessary complexity. 

Through trial and error on professional sets, she discovered that many budget-friendly items—such as dependable mascaras, hydrating lip oils, and lightweight concealers—perform just as well as, if not better than, their high-end counterparts. By integrating these reliable, accessible products into her regimen, Burns keeps her daily process practical, economical, and effortlessly repeatable.

### Targeted Application for a Natural, Healthy Glow

Rather than layering on heavy foundations or attempting complex contouring, Burns focuses on targeted application tricks designed to enhance, rather than mask, her features. Her goal for everyday makeup is a healthy, lit-from-within glow that can be achieved in a matter of minutes.

She prioritizes multi-use cream formulas—like cream blushes and subtle highlighters—that can be applied quickly with the fingertips to warm up the skin and catch the light naturally. A quick sweep of mascara to define the lashes, a groomed brow, and a wash of neutral color on the lips complete a look that emphasizes her facial structure while looking entirely fresh-faced. 

### The Takeaway: Sophistication in Simplicity

Brooke Burns’ approach offers a refreshing masterclass in beauty minimalism. By prioritizing hair health, trusting proven drugstore staples, and mastering a few quick-application techniques, she proves that achieving a sophisticated, luminous look doesn't require an army of stylists or hours in front of the mirror. Ultimately, her routine demonstrates that when you focus on what genuinely works for you, minimal effort can yield maximum confidence and timeless elegance.

# Beauty Talk: Brooke Burns Spills Her Skin & Makeup Secrets

By InStyle Staff

Whether she’s turning heads on the red carpet or chasing after her daughter, Rowan, former *Baywatch* beauty and TV host Brooke Burns always manages to look effortlessly radiant. How does the 30-year-old Texas-born stunner maintain that gorgeous California glow? We sat down with Brooke to chat about her go-to skincare regimen, her favorite hair color, the makeup trick she swears by, and a hilarious throwback from her high school days.

---

**InStyle:** You always look so sun-kissed and fresh-faced. What is the top secret behind your makeup routine?

**Brooke Burns:** Thank you! My biggest makeup secret is actually layering creams instead of powders. When I'm working, I get powdered down so much for the cameras, which can end up looking a little heavy in real life. On my own time, I love a good cream blush—NARS Multiple in Orgasm is my absolute holy grail. I dab it on the apples of my cheeks and a tiny bit on my lips. Then, I mix a drop of liquid illuminator into my tinted moisturizer. It gives you that 'I just got back from a tropical vacation' dewiness without looking greasy. Oh, and I never, *ever* leave the house without curling my eyelashes and popping on some lip gloss!

**InStyle:** Speaking of glowing skin, what does your daily skincare routine look like?

**Brooke Burns:** I’m a big believer in keeping it simple because if a routine has ten steps, I know I won't stick to it. Every morning, I wash my face with a super gentle cleanser—Cetaphil has been my staple forever. Then, I spray a bit of rosewater toner to wake up my skin, followed by a light moisturizer with SPF 30. Sunscreen is non-negotiable for me! At night, I like to splurge a little more. I’ll do a double cleanse to get all the camera makeup off, and then I use Crème de la Mer or a rich night cream from Dermalogica. If my skin feels extra tired from travel, I’ll sleep in a hydrating gel mask. 

**InStyle:** You’ve rocked a few different looks over the years, from deep brunette to bright blonde. Which hair color do you feel most like *yourself* in?

**Brooke Burns:** Definitely honey blonde! I went quite dark brunette for a role a few years back, and while it was fun to play a moody alter-ego for a minute, I felt so out of my element. The moment I walked out of the salon back to a warm, golden blonde with bright highlights around my face, I felt like myself again. I think being a southern girl who spent so much time in the sun, golden blonde just fits my personality best. Blondes really do have more fun!

**InStyle:** We love a good beauty throwback. When you think back to your teenage years, what was your high school nickname, and did it match your vibe back then?

**Brooke Burns:** [Laughs] Oh gosh, my friends used to call me "Burnsy," which wasn't super creative, but it stuck! But my ballet teachers and close pals called me "Giraffe." I had a massive growth spurt when I was about fourteen—I hit 5'8" almost overnight—and I was all arms and legs. I felt so gangly and awkward! I was doing serious ballet training at the time, so I was constantly stretching to try and grow into my tall frame. I definitely didn't feel like a glamorous model back then; I was just a goofy, super-tall kid named Burnsy trying not to trip over my own feet!

---

### **Brooke's Beauty Must-Haves (2008 Edit):**
* **NARS** The Multiple in *Orgasm*, $38
* **Cetaphil** Gentle Skin Cleanser, $8
* **Lancôme** Juicy Tubes Lip Gloss in *Simmer*, $18
* **Kérastase** Reflect Intensive Shinening Care for Blonde Hair, $34

**OCTOBER 2005** — Whether she’s dodging drama on the hit WB series *Sunset Beach High* or floating down the red carpet in vintage Betsey Johnson, 21-year-old Chloe Montgomery always looks effortlessly sun-kissed. But while most Hollywood starlets spend their hard-earned paychecks on pricey La Mer creams and facialists to the stars, Chloe insists her daily beauty routine costs less than a pair of Premium Express jeans. 

We caught up with the blonde babe at her cozy Hollywood Hills pad—where she greeted us in velvet Juicy Couture sweatpants and a crystal-embellished Von Dutch trucker hat—to get the scoop on the cheapie products she can’t live without.

***

**GLAMOUR & GLOSS:** Chloe! You look amazing. Your skin is glowing! What’s your secret?

**CHLOE MONTGOMERY:** Oh my gosh, thank you! Honestly, everyone thinks I spend thousands at Fred Segal, but I’m a total aisle-hopper at CVS. My absolute holy grail cleanser is **Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser** ($5.99). My makeup artist on set got me hooked on it. It takes off all the heavy TV camera makeup without drying me out. 

**G&G:** No way! What about ex-foli-a-tion? 

**CHLOE:** *[Laughs]* Okay, I am obsessed—literally *obsessed*—with the **St. Ives Fresh Skin Apricot Scrub** ($3.49). I keep a tub in my shower and use it twice a week. It smells like literal summer and keeps my skin so smooth. 

**G&G:** You’ve got that signature California bronzed look going on. Are you a sunbather?

**CHLOE:** Heck no! Tanning beds are so out, and wrinkles are not cute! After I shower, I lather up with **Jergens Natural Glow Daily Moisturizer** ($6.99). It gives you the most gorgeous, natural streak-free tan over a few days. Plus, it doesn’t have that weird fake-tan smell. My boyfriend thought I spent the weekend in Cabo!

> **“Everyone thinks I spend thousands at Fred Segal, but I’m a total aisle-hopper at CVS.”**

**G&G:** Let’s talk makeup. What’s in your purse right now?

**CHLOE:** Okay, let me dig into my Balenciaga... [pulls out items]. First up, mascara. I don’t care what anyone says, **Maybelline Great Lash** ($4.49)—the iconic pink and green tube!—is the best mascara on the planet. I get the shade *Very Black*. It makes my lashes look so long and fluttery without clumping. 

**G&G:** And for lips? We’re loving the ultra-shiny lip look on the red carpet right now.

**CHLOE:** You *have* to try **CoverGirl WetSlicks Lipgloss** in *Clear* or *Fruit Splash* ($4.29). It’s not super sticky, so your hair doesn’t get glued to your lips when the wind blows! But if I’m just hanging out, I always have a tube of **Dr. Pepper Lip Smackers** ($1.50) in my pocket. It leaves the perfect sheer berry tint, and it tastes so nostalgic.

**G&G:** Your hair always looks incredibly sleek, even with the L.A. humidity. How do you tame the frizz?

**CHLOE:** After I flat-iron my hair—I'm totally addicted to my CHI straightener—I run two drops of **Garnier Fructis Sleek & Shine Anti-Frizz Serum** ($4.99) through my ends. It smells like tropical fruit and gives you that liquid glass shine. A little goes a long way, so one bottle lasts forever!

**G&G:** What’s the best piece of budget beauty advice you’ve ever gotten?

**CHLOE:** Drink tons of water, always take your makeup off before bed, and never feel like you need a designer logo on your mascara to look fabulous! 

***

### INSIDE CHLOE’S BEAUTY BAG (FOR UNDER $30!)

* **Maybelline Great Lash Mascara** in *Very Black*, $4.49
* **CoverGirl WetSlicks Lipgloss** in *Fruit Splash*, $4.29
* **Jergens Natural Glow Daily Moisturizer**, $6.99
* **St. Ives Fresh Skin Apricot Scrub**, $3.49
* **Garnier Fructis Sleek & Shine Serum**, $4.99
* **Bonne Bell Lip Smackers** in *Dr. Pepper*, $1.50

**TOTAL:** $25.75

# Beauty Talk: *Miss Guided* Star Brooke Burns on Drugstore Holy Grails and Her Secret to Glowing Skin

*By InStyle Staff*

Whether she’s turning heads on the red carpet or making us laugh on her hit comedy *Miss Guided*, Brooke Burns always manages to look effortlessly radiant. But behind that red-carpet glow is a woman who appreciates a good beauty bargain just as much as we do. 

We caught up with the actress to chat about her early makeup mishaps, the budget-friendly foundation she swears by, and the classic skincare brand that keeps her skin camera-ready.

***

**InStyle: Let’s go back to the beginning. What were your earliest childhood makeup experiments like?**

**Brooke Burns:** Oh, pure chaos! I think every little girl has a phase where she steals her mom's makeup bag, and I was definitely guilty. I was around eight years old, and I snuck into my mother's bathroom and applied bright electric-blue eyeshadow all the way up to my eyebrows, paired with a frosty pink lipstick that I smeared way past my lip line. I thought I looked like a supermodel! My mom walked in, took one look at me, and couldn't stop laughing. It was my first lesson in "less is more."

**InStyle: You’ve worked with the best makeup artists in the business, but we hear you’re a big fan of high-low beauty. What’s your go-to drugstore foundation?**

**BB:** I love a high-low mix! You truly don’t have to spend a fortune to get incredible skin. My absolute holy grail is **L'Oréal Paris True Match Super-Blendable Makeup**. It’s lightweight, doesn’t settle into fine lines, and gives the most natural, glowing finish. When I’m shooting long days on the set of *Miss Guided*, it stays put without feeling heavy. I actually prefer it over a lot of the luxury brands I’ve tried!

**InStyle: Your skin always looks so plump and hydrated. What does your everyday skincare routine look like?**

**BB:** Honestly, I keep it really simple, and I owe a lot of my skin's happiness to **Olay**. My grandmother used classic Olay, my mom used it, and now I swear by it. I use the **Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream** every single morning and night. It’s super rich without being greasy, and it gives your skin this immediate, juicy bounce. If I’m traveling or running around on set, I’ll also grab the Olay Daily Facials water-activated cleansing cloths—they make removing heavy camera makeup so easy. 

**InStyle: What’s the single best piece of beauty advice you’ve ever gotten?**

**BB:** Hydrate from the inside out, wear your sunscreen, and never take yourself too seriously—even if you happen to be wearing blue eyeshadow!

***

*Catch Brooke Burns in **Miss Guided**, airing Thursdays at 8/7c.*
